title: Desk display: four wires from the OLED to the LP-EM-CC2340R5
warning: Probe stays clipped on. Wire with USB unplugged. The OLED takes 3.3 V, never the 5 V pin

label: Power: J1 pin 1 (3V3) to OLED VCC,
J3 pin 22 (GND) to OLED GND.
3V3 is the top pin of J1; GND is the
second pin of the inner row, J3.
Use 3V3, not pin 21 (5V).
Bus: J1 pin 9 (DIO24, I2C_SCL) to OLED SCL,
J1 pin 10 (DIO0, I2C_SDA) to OLED SDA.
The module's own pull-ups hold the lines
up; the LaunchPad has none. ELEGOO prints
GND, VCC, SCL, SDA in that order.
